text_block_list.text:
Hearing that an instructor from a 
prestigious academy that trains horse 
girls was holding a talk event, I decided 
to attend. In front of the venue—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, a familiar face. So you have come to 
listen to my mother's lecture as well. An 
admirable attitude.
choice_data_list: Wait, today's instructor is your mother?!
Wait, today's instructor is your mother?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You came without knowing, you fool? The 
wisdom of my mother, who has nurtured 
countless horse girls—know that every 
single word she speaks is pure gold!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And so, the key point to this training 
is... You go *ping*, then *squeeze*, and 
pull it *whoosh*, like that!
choice_data_list:
(Wh-What do I do, I don't understand a 
single thing...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. While keeping the spine straight, 
tense the abdominal muscles and apply the 
load to the gluteus maximus.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just having this awareness will 
drastically improve the quality of one's 
training. As expected of Mother...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
When guiding children, grasp each of their 
running habits and—ah, hold on a sec! My 
nose is tingling, eh, eh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: A-A-ACHOO!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M-Magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Without minding public gaze, sneezing with 
all her might with such boldness... What 
tremendous mental fortitude...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That must surely be the secret to how 
Mother achieved success on the grandest 
race stages. I have much to learn from 
her...!
choice_data_list:
(Her respect is heading in a bizarre 
direction...)

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Now then, from here, while watching 
footage of famous races from her active 
career, let us look back on those days—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, wait! Video is nice and all, 
but... How about we reenact that race 
right here right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Seeing it in person is way more 
informative! For my rival... Air Groove, 
I'm counting on you♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M-Me...?! But I have prepared nothing...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! You watched the 
footage of the Oaks over and over since 
you were little! Come on, up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: U-Understood...

And so, with a backdrop displaying the 
racetrack scenery, the mother-daughter 
co-starring performance was realized, 
however—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Then, coming down to the final straight, 
neck and neck—alright! Here comes rival 
number 9 from the outside! Coming in with 
a *WHOOSH*!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Whooosh...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No good with such a cute expression! Glare 
at me much more fiercely!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
G-Glare at Mother...?! Hrmm... L-Like 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Give me a much sharper scowl! 
Redo from the *WHOOSH*!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh, fr-from the whoosh again...?!
choice_data_list:
(Air Groove seems to be having a rough 
time...)

(Air Groove seems to be having a rough 
time...)

text_block_list.text:
After numerous retakes, Air Groove's 
mother's talk event concluded without 
further incident—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: *Pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
M... Mother, to drag me onto the stage 
without any prior rehearsal, even I must 
admit...

It is only natural for Air Groove to say 
so. Indeed, it was a bit too much—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can barely contain the deep inspiration 
swelling within my chest...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It served as the finest arena to temper my 
mental fortitude...! I am truly grateful 
to you for granting me such an invaluable 
opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must reflect on the teachings bestowed 
upon me and engrave them into body and 
soul...! If you will excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Man, whether to call her overly serious or 
just typical for her...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess... when the mother is 
irresponsible, the daughter feels 
compelled to pull herself together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, no use overthinking it. Maybe I 
should invite her out on a date as an 
apology.

It turned into a day where I learned about 
the rather peculiar parent-child 
relationship between Air Groove and her 
mother.
